fix(core): bound decoded plist bytes and harden lookups

- Charge string and data bytes against a 64 MiB budget before
  allocating, so a large value referenced many times from a small
  binary plist can't exhaust memory.
- Resolve XML entities and real specials on own keys only, so
  &constructor; and <real>__proto__</real> fail instead of decoding.
- Push array items one at a time in the reference walker; spreading a
  200,000-item array exceeded the engine's argument limit.
- Require every truncated seed to be rejected, not just to not leak.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
